Job Title: Surveillance Developer 

 Duration: 12+ Months (Possibility of Extension)
 Location: Rockville, MD
 

 The surveillance developer should have very good communication skills (emphasized this) since he will be supporting QA's & BA's and working with 5 other developers. The candidate should be able to think out of the box and be strong minded.  
 

 Day to day will be creating brand new surveillances and upgrades of the applications in place
 Mid-SR. Level Surveillance Developer 
 • Hive experience will eventually be a must so should have experience (not extensively but if has solid understanding)
 • Specifically *advanced analytical SQL
 • Candidates must be very strong with analytical SQL
 • Data mining / data analysis 
 • Candidates with a background of programming is ideal 
 • C/C++/Java/Shell/Python/Perl 
 • If only experience on Windows not good must have utilized Unix/Linux or multiple 
 • Framework Scripting 
 • R language is plus 
 

 Look for SQL developer or background with programming with strong SQL


 To know more about the position, please contact:
